article.title: Apple’s new AI split means your iOS app could behave differently in China
article.summary: Apple is splitting up its AI stack. Instead of rolling out the same system worldwide, the company reportedly built a China-only model with help from Alibaba to navigate the country’s tough regulatory hurdles. Reuters reported Friday that Apple’s new model is expected to work alongside Alibaba’s Qwen and possibly technology from Baidu. Neither Apple nor its Chinese partners has explained which model will handle each part of Apple Intelligence. Although no launch date has been announced yet, Reuters expects the service to arrive in China within the next few months. article.title: Pixel phones could soon monitor outgoing calls for scams, too
article.summary: TL;DR Pixel phones offer a feature that monitors incoming calls for scams. We’ve seen evidence Scam Detection could soon cover outgoing calls, too. We don’t know when this feature will be available to users. Google’s modern Pixel phones offer a Scam Detection feature that optionally monitors incoming calls for telltale signs of scams. Scam Detection is currently exclusive to incoming calls, but we’ve seen evidence that you might soon be able to opt into Scam Detection for outgoing calls, too. In a recent beta version of the Phone by Google app, we spotted a flag that references the option to turn on Sharpie (an internal codename for the Scam Detection feature) for calls you initiate. We haven’t been able to activate Scam Detection for outgoing calls, but we know Google’s working on it.

article.title: LG joins forces with Nvidia to build AI-powered robots and hardware for self-driving cars
article.summary: Chairman and CEO of LG Corp. Kwang Mo Koo visited the Nvidia headquarters at Santa Clara, California, to sign a memorandum of understanding with CEO Jensen Huang. This memorandum focuses on expanding the AI capabilities of both companies. LG and Nvidia CEOs posing with a miniature humanoid robot The headline-grabbing announcement is that LG plans to unveil a humanoid robot in the first quarter of 2027. article.title: Meta Faces Landmark Trial Over Youth Harm Claims
article.summary: Meta faces a landmark federal trial brought by 29 states over allegations that Facebook and Instagram were deliberately designed to addict young users and that the company improperly collected children’s data. Bloomberg News Tech Reporter Alexandra Levine joins Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar on Bloomberg This Weekend to explain that the case could expose Meta to substantial penalties and potentially more consequential court-ordered changes to how its platforms operate. (Source: Bloomberg)
